correctness.rationale: For O=B_1^3, the radius of the centrally symmetric Euclidean plane section is 1/min_{u∈E∩S^2}||u||_1. On fixed-sign great-circle arcs the positive ell1 norm equals a sinusoid, whose interior critical point (if any) is a maximum, so minima occur at coordinate-zero directions. Their radii are sqrt(n_j²+n_k²)/(|n_j|+|n_k|). Since f(t)=sqrt(1+t²)/(1+t) decreases on [0,1], the extreme coordinate pair a=min|n_i|, c=max|n_i| determines D=2sqrt(a²+c²)/(a+c). For Haar normal, ordered positive octant ratio T=a/c>=t is a spherical triangle with rays (1,1,1),(t,t,1),(t,1,1); six congruent sectors and van Oosterom–Strackee's exact solid-angle formula produce the 24/pi arctangent CDF. I independently evaluated the spherical determinant expression and an analytically independent Gaussian half-normal order-statistics integral at six thresholds, agreeing within 1e-11. Endpoints D∈[sqrt2,2], zero atoms, special zero/repeated normal coordinates by continuity are correctly handled. The finite checker is supporting evidence only.
